messages.content: 오늘 실행된 모든 실행 내역을 보여줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE DATE(started_at) = DATE('now');
툴 호출 비용이 가장 높은 상위 5개 툴 이름과 총 비용을 알려줘
SELECT tool_name, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 5;
에이전트 타입별로 몇 개의 에이전트가 있는지 조회해줘
SELECT agent_type, COUNT(*) AS agent_count FROM agents GROUP BY agent_type;
한 번도 실행된 적 없는 에이전트를 찾아줘
SELECT a.agent_id, a.agent_name FROM agents a LEFT JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id WHERE e.execution_id IS NULL;
평균 지연 시간이 3000ms 이상인 에이전트만 보여주세요
SELECT a.agent_name, AVG(e.latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name HAVING AVG(e.latency_ms) >= 3000;
가장 최근에 만들어진 에이전트 3개가 뭐야?
SELECT * FROM agents ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3;
실행 상태별 건수를 집계해서 보여줘
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM executions GROUP BY status;
툴 호출 중 input_tokens이 1000개를 초과한 기록만 조회해줘
SELECT * FROM tool_calls WHERE input_tokens > 1000;
에이전트별 총 툴 호출 비용을 내림차순으로 알려주세요

SELECT a.agent_name, SUM(tc.cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM tool_calls tc JOIN executions e ON tc.execution_id = e.execution_id JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC;
성공한 실행 중 지연 시간이 가장 짧은 실행 10개를 보여줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE status = 'success' ORDER BY latency_ms ASC LIMIT 10;
툴 호출이 한 번도 없었던 실행 내역을 찾아줘
SELECT e.* FROM executions e LEFT JOIN tool_calls tc ON e.execution_id = tc.execution_id WHERE tc.tool_call_id IS NULL;
각 실행별로 총 툴 호출 횟수와 총 비용을 같이 보여주세요
SELECT e.execution_id, COUNT(tc.tool_call_id) AS call_count, SUM(tc.cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM executions e LEFT JOIN tool_calls tc ON e.execution_id = tc.execution_id GROUP BY e.execution_id;
에러 메시지에 'timeout'이 포함된 실행 목록 조회해줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE error_message LIKE '%timeout%';
가장 많이 호출된 툴 이름 순으로 전체 목록 보여줘
SELECT tool_name, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY call_count DESC;
2024년에 생성된 에이전트 중 'llm' 타입인 것만 알려줘
SELECT * FROM agents WHERE agent_type = 'llm' AND strftime('%Y', created_at) = '2024';
실행 시간이 1시간 이상 걸린 실행만 보여줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE (julianday(ended_at) - julianday(started_at)) * 24 >= 1;
툴 호출 건수가 5회 이상인 실행의 에이전트 이름과 실행 ID를 알려주세요

SELECT a.agent_name, e.execution_id, COUNT(tc.tool_call_id) AS call_count FROM tool_calls tc JOIN executions e ON tc.execution_id = e.execution_id JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY e.execution_id, a.agent_name HAVING COUNT(tc.tool_call_id) >= 5;
output_tokens 합계가 가장 높은 실행 ID를 찾아줘
SELECT execution_id, SUM(output_tokens) AS total_output_tokens FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id ORDER BY total_output_tokens DESC LIMIT 1;
실패한 실행이 한 건도 없는 에이전트 목록을 보여주세요
SELECT * FROM agents WHERE agent_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT agent_id FROM executions WHERE status = 'failed');
각 에이전트의 마지막 실행 시각과 상태를 조회해줘

SELECT a.agent_name, e.started_at, e.status FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE e.started_at = (SELECT MAX(e2.started_at) FROM executions e2 WHERE e2.agent_id = e.agent_id);
가장 최근에 생성된 에이전트 5개를 보여줘
SELECT * FROM agents ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
성공한 실행의 평균 지연 시간(ms)을 에이전트별로 알려줘
SELECT a.agent_name, AVG(e.latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE e.status = 'success' GROUP BY a.agent_name;
툴 호출이 한 번도 없었던 실행 목록을 조회해줘
SELECT e.* FROM executions e LEFT JOIN tool_calls tc ON e.execution_id = tc.execution_id WHERE tc.tool_call_id IS NULL;
전체 실행 중 에러 메시지가 있는 실행만 보여주세요
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE error_message IS NOT NULL;
툴별로 총 비용이 얼마나 발생했는지 내림차순으로 정렬해서 알려줘
SELECT tool_name, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC;
실행 횟수가 10번 이상인 에이전트만 추려줘
SELECT a.agent_name, COUNT(e.execution_id) AS execution_count FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name HAVING COUNT(e.execution_id) >= 10;
가장 비용이 많이 든 툴 호출 상위 3개를 조회해줘
SELECT * FROM tool_calls ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 3;
에이전트 타입별로 몇 개의 에이전트가 있는지 알려주세요
SELECT agent_type, COUNT(*) AS agent_count FROM agents GROUP BY agent_type;
지연 시간이 5000ms를 초과한 실행이 있는 에이전트 이름을 알고 싶어
SELECT DISTINCT a.agent_name FROM agents a JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id WHERE e.latency_ms > 5000;
아직 한 번도 실행된 적 없는 에이전트를 찾아줘
SELECT a.* FROM agents a LEFT JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id WHERE e.execution_id IS NULL;
실행별 총 input_tokens과 output_tokens 합계를 보여줘
SELECT execution_id, SUM(input_tokens) AS total_input, SUM(output_tokens) AS total_output FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id;
2024년에 시작된 실행 목록을 조회해줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE started_at >= '2024-01-01' AND started_at < '2025-01-01';
평균 지연 시간이 가장 긴 에이전트를 찾아줘
SELECT a.agent_name, AVG(e.latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name ORDER BY avg_latency DESC LIMIT 1;
실행 상태별 건수를 요약해서 보여주세요
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM executions GROUP BY status;
특정 실행에서 호출된 툴 목록과 각 비용을 실행 ID와 함께 조회해줘
SELECT tc.execution_id, tc.tool_name, tc.cost_usd FROM tool_calls tc ORDER BY tc.execution_id;
총 비용이 가장 높은 실행의 에이전트 이름과 비용을 알려줘

SELECT a.agent_name, SUM(tc.cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM tool_calls tc JOIN executions e ON tc.execution_id = e.execution_id JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY e.execution_id, a.agent_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 1;
실패한 실행 중 지연 시간이 가장 짧은 것부터 순서대로 보여줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE status = 'failed' ORDER BY latency_ms ASC;
툴 호출을 3번 이상 한 실행 ID를 알려줘
SELECT execution_id, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;
각 에이전트의 성공률(성공 건수 / 전체 실행 건수)을 계산해서 보여줘
SELECT a.agent_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name;
가장 최근에 실행된 각 에이전트의 마지막 실행 시각을 알고 싶어
SELECT a.agent_name, MAX(e.started_at) AS last_started FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name;
가장 최근에 생성된 에이전트 5개를 알려줘
SELECT * FROM agents ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
평균 레이턴시가 1000ms 이상인 에이전트 목록을 조회해줘
SELECT a.agent_name, AVG(e.latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name HAVING AVG(e.latency_ms) >= 1000;
툴 호출이 한 번도 없었던 실행 목록을 보여줘
SELECT e.* FROM executions e LEFT JOIN tool_calls tc ON e.execution_id = tc.execution_id WHERE tc.tool_call_id IS NULL;
에이전트 타입별로 총 실행 횟수를 집계해줘
SELECT a.agent_type, COUNT(e.execution_id) AS total_executions FROM agents a LEFT JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_type;
실행 비용이 가장 높은 툴 호출 상위 10개를 내림차순으로 보여주세요
SELECT * FROM tool_calls ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 10;
아직 실행 기록이 없는 에이전트를 찾아줘
SELECT a.* FROM agents a LEFT JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id WHERE e.execution_id IS NULL;
툴별로 평균 입력 토큰 수와 평균 출력 토큰 수를 알려줘
SELECT tool_name, AVG(input_tokens) AS avg_input_tokens, AVG(output_tokens) AS avg_output_tokens FROM tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name;
오늘 실행된 것 중 status가 success인 실행들의 평균 레이턴시는 얼마야?
SELECT AVG(latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM executions WHERE status = 'success' AND DATE(started_at) = DATE('now');
에러 메시지가 존재하는 실행 건수를 에이전트별로 보여주세요
SELECT a.agent_name, COUNT(e.execution_id) AS error_count FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE e.error_message IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.agent_name ORDER BY error_count DESC;
전체 툴 호출 중 총 비용 합계를 조회해줘
SELECT SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM tool_calls;
가장 많은 툴을 호출한 실행 ID 상위 5개를 알려줘
SELECT execution_id, COUNT(tool_call_id) AS tool_call_count FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id ORDER BY tool_call_count DESC LIMIT 5;
실행 시간이 가장 길었던 실행(ended_at - started_at 기준) 3개를 보여줘
SELECT *, (JULIANDAY(ended_at) - JULIANDAY(started_at)) * 86400 AS duration_sec FROM executions WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY duration_sec DESC LIMIT 3;
각 에이전트의 성공률(success 비율)을 계산해서 보여주세요

SELECT a.agent_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(e.execution_id), 2) AS success_rate FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name;
총 비용이 10달러를 초과한 툴 이름만 뽑아줘
SELECT tool_name, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name HAVING SUM(cost_usd) > 10;
최근 7일 이내에 실행된 건 중 failed 상태인 것들의 에러 메시지를 조회해줘
SELECT execution_id, error_message, started_at FROM executions WHERE status = 'failed' AND started_at >= DATE('now', '-7 days');
실행 한 건당 평균 툴 호출 횟수가 가장 높은 에이전트를 알려줘

SELECT a.agent_name, AVG(tc_count) AS avg_tool_calls FROM (SELECT e.execution_id, e.agent_id, COUNT(tc.tool_call_id) AS tc_count FROM executions e LEFT JOIN tool_calls tc ON e.execution_id = tc.execution_id GROUP BY e.execution_id, e.agent_id) sub JOIN agents a ON sub.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name ORDER BY avg_tool_calls DESC LIMIT 1;
같은 툴을 5번 이상 호출한 실행 ID 목록 보여줘
SELECT execution_id, tool_name, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id, tool_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;
agent_type이 'llm'인 에이전트들의 전체 실행 목록을 조회해줘
SELECT e.* FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE a.agent_type = 'llm';
입력 토큰과 출력 토큰의 합이 가장 큰 툴 호출 상위 5개를 알려주세요
SELECT *, (input_tokens + output_tokens) AS total_tokens FROM tool_calls ORDER BY total_tokens DESC LIMIT 5;
실행이 존재하지만 ended_at이 null인, 즉 아직 종료되지 않은 실행 목록을 보여줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE ended_at IS NULL;
가장 최근에 생성된 에이전트 5개를 알려줘
SELECT * FROM agents ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
평균 레이턴시가 1000ms 이상인 에이전트 목록을 조회해줘
SELECT a.agent_name, AVG(e.latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name HAVING AVG(e.latency_ms) >= 1000;
툴 호출이 한 번도 없었던 실행 목록을 보여줘
SELECT e.* FROM executions e LEFT JOIN tool_calls tc ON e.execution_id = tc.execution_id WHERE tc.tool_call_id IS NULL;
각 에이전트 타입별 총 실행 횟수가 궁금해
SELECT a.agent_type, COUNT(e.execution_id) AS total_executions FROM agents a LEFT JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_type;
비용이 가장 많이 든 툴 호출 상위 10개를 조회해줘
SELECT * FROM tool_calls ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 10;
성공한 실행들의 평균, 최소, 최대 레이턴시를 알려주세요
SELECT AVG(latency_ms) AS avg_latency, MIN(latency_ms) AS min_latency, MAX(latency_ms) AS max_latency FROM executions WHERE status = 'success';
실행 기록이 전혀 없는 에이전트를 찾아줘
SELECT a.* FROM agents a LEFT JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id WHERE e.execution_id IS NULL;
툴별 총 비용과 평균 입력 토큰 수를 내림차순으로 보여주세요
SELECT tool_name, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost, AVG(input_tokens) AS avg_input_tokens FROM tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC;
2024년 이후에 시작된 실행 중 에러 메시지가 있는 것만 조회해줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE started_at >= '2024-01-01' AND error_message IS NOT NULL;
에이전트별로 가장 최근 실행 시간을 알고 싶어
SELECT a.agent_name, MAX(e.started_at) AS last_executed_at FROM agents a LEFT JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name;
툴 호출을 5번 이상 한 실행 ID와 해당 툴 호출 횟수를 보여줘
SELECT execution_id, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;
각 실행의 총 비용과 총 출력 토큰 수를 함께 보여줘
SELECT execution_id, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost, SUM(output_tokens) AS total_output_tokens FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id;
가장 많은 종류의 툴을 사용한 에이전트는 누구야?

SELECT a.agent_name, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.tool_name) AS unique_tools FROM agents a JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id JOIN tool_calls tc ON e.execution_id = tc.execution_id GROUP BY a.agent_name ORDER BY unique_tools DESC LIMIT 1;
실패한 실행 중 레이턴시가 가장 높은 것의 에이전트 이름과 에러 메시지를 알려줘
SELECT a.agent_name, e.error_message, e.latency_ms FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE e.status = 'failed' ORDER BY e.latency_ms DESC LIMIT 1;
전체 툴 호출에서 툴별 사용 비율(%)을 조회해줘
SELECT tool_name, COUNT(*) AS call_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tool_calls), 2) AS usage_percent FROM tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY usage_percent DESC;
하루 평균 실행 횟수가 가장 많은 에이전트를 알려주세요

SELECT a.agent_name, COUNT(e.execution_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.started_at)) AS avg_daily_executions FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name ORDER BY avg_daily_executions DESC LIMIT 1;
총 비용이 100달러를 초과한 적 있는 실행에 연결된 에이전트 목록을 보여줘
SELECT DISTINCT a.agent_name FROM agents a JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id WHERE e.execution_id IN (SELECT execution_id FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id HAVING SUM(cost_usd) > 100);
종료 시간이 없는(아직 끝나지 않은) 실행 목록을 조회해줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE ended_at IS NULL;
같은 날 생성된 에이전트가 2개 이상인 날짜를 알려줘
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS creation_date, COUNT(*) AS agent_count FROM agents GROUP BY DATE(created_at) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
에이전트 타입이 'llm'인 에이전트들의 성공률(%)을 보여주세요

SELECT a.agent_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(e.execution_id), 2) AS success_rate FROM agents a JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id WHERE a.agent_type = 'llm' GROUP BY a.agent_name;
오늘 실행된 execution 목록을 보여줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE DATE(started_at) = DATE('now');
각 툴별로 총 호출 횟수를 집계해줘
SELECT tool_name, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY call_count DESC;
지금까지 가장 많은 비용이 발생한 상위 5개 실행을 알려주세요
SELECT execution_id, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 5;
실행 상태가 'success'인 execution의 평균 latency는 얼마야?
SELECT AVG(latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM executions WHERE status = 'success';
한 번도 실행된 적 없는 에이전트를 조회해줘
SELECT a.* FROM agents a LEFT JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id WHERE e.execution_id IS NULL;
tool_call이 5번 이상 발생한 execution_id만 보여줘
SELECT execution_id, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id HAVING call_count >= 5;
에이전트 타입별로 평균 실행 시간(latency_ms)을 알려주세요
SELECT a.agent_type, AVG(e.latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_type;
가장 최근에 생성된 에이전트 3개를 조회해줘
SELECT * FROM agents ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT e.execution_id, a.agent_name, e.error_message, e.started_at FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE e.error_message IS NOT NULL AND e.error_message != '';

SELECT * FROM tool_calls ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 5;
에이전트별 평균 실행 지연시간을 구해줘
SELECT a.agent_name, AVG(e.latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name;
한 번도 실행된 적 없는 에이전트를 찾아줘
SELECT a.* FROM agents a LEFT JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id WHERE e.execution_id IS NULL;
툴 이름별 총 비용과 평균 비용을 집계해줘
SELECT tool_name, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost, AVG(cost_usd) AS avg_cost FROM tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name;
실행 성공률이 50% 미만인 에이전트만 보여주세요

SELECT a.agent_name, SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS success_rate FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name HAVING success_rate < 50;
가장 많은 툴을 호출한 execution_id 순으로 조회해줘
SELECT execution_id, COUNT(*) AS tool_call_count FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id ORDER BY tool_call_count DESC;
에러 메시지가 있는 실행 중 latency가 가장 긴 것 10개만 알려줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE error_message IS NOT NULL ORDER BY latency_ms DESC LIMIT 10;
각 에이전트가 사용한 총 토큰 수(input + output)를 구해주세요

SELECT a.agent_name, SUM(tc.input_tokens + tc.output_tokens) AS total_tokens FROM tool_calls tc JOIN executions e ON tc.execution_id = e.execution_id JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name;
최근 7일 이내에 생성된 에이전트 목록 조회해줘
SELECT * FROM agents WHERE created_at >= DATE('now', '-7 days');
툴 호출이 한 번도 없었던 execution을 찾아줘
SELECT e.* FROM executions e LEFT JOIN tool_calls tc ON e.execution_id = tc.execution_id WHERE tc.tool_call_id IS NULL;
status별 평균 latency를 보여줘
SELECT status, AVG(latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM executions GROUP BY status;
총 비용이 1달러 이상 발생한 execution만 알려줘
SELECT execution_id, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id HAVING total_cost >= 1.0;
가장 최근에 실행된 에이전트 이름과 실행 시작 시각을 보여주세요
SELECT a.agent_name, e.started_at FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id ORDER BY e.started_at DESC LIMIT 1;
input_tokens이 가장 많이 사용된 툴 이름 상위 3개를 알려줘
SELECT tool_name, SUM(input_tokens) AS total_input_tokens FROM tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY total_input_tokens DESC LIMIT 3;
실행 시간이 1시간 이상 걸린 execution의 에이전트 이름과 시작/종료 시각을 조회해줘
SELECT a.agent_name, e.started_at, e.ended_at FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE (JULIANDAY(e.ended_at) - JULIANDAY(e.started_at)) * 24 >= 1;
평균 툴 호출 비용이 가장 높은 에이전트 타입은 뭐야?

SELECT a.agent_type, AVG(tc.cost_usd) AS avg_cost FROM tool_calls tc JOIN executions e ON tc.execution_id = e.execution_id JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_type ORDER BY avg_cost DESC LIMIT 1;
전체 실행 건수가 10건 이상이고 그 중 failed 상태인 비율이 30% 이상인 에이전트를 보여줘

SELECT a.agent_name, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS failed_rate FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name HAVING total_count >= 10 AND failed_rate >= 30;
오늘 실행된 execution 목록을 보여줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE DATE(started_at) = DATE('now');
각 에이전트 타입별로 몇 개씩 있는지 알려줘
SELECT agent_type, COUNT(*) AS agent_count FROM agents GROUP BY agent_type;
가장 최근에 만들어진 에이전트 5개를 조회해줘
SELECT * FROM agents ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
툴 호출 비용이 가장 많이 든 실행 ID와 총 비용을 알려줘
SELECT execution_id, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 1;
실행 시간이 10초(10000ms) 이상인 실행 목록을 보여주세요
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE latency_ms >= 10000;
한 번도 실행된 적 없는 에이전트를 찾아줘
SELECT a.* FROM agents a LEFT JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id WHERE e.execution_id IS NULL;
툴별로 평균 입력 토큰 수와 평균 출력 토큰 수를 집계해줘
SELECT tool_name, AVG(input_tokens) AS avg_input_tokens, AVG(output_tokens) AS avg_output_tokens FROM tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name;
성공한 실행의 평균 레이턴시를 에이전트 이름과 함께 보여줘
SELECT a.agent_name, AVG(e.latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE e.status = 'success' GROUP BY a.agent_name;
툴 호출을 5번 이상 한 실행 ID만 조회해줘
SELECT execution_id, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM tool_calls GROUP BY execution_id HAVING call_count >= 5;
에러 메시지가 있는 실행 중 가장 최근 것 10개를 보여주세요
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE error_message IS NOT NULL ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 10;
에이전트 이름과 해당 에이전트의 전체 실행 횟수, 성공 횟수를 함께 알려줘

SELECT a.agent_name, COUNT(e.execution_id) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count FROM agents a LEFT JOIN executions e ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_name;
전체 툴 호출 중 비용이 발생하지 않은 건수를 알려줘
SELECT COUNT(*) AS free_calls FROM tool_calls WHERE cost_usd = 0 OR cost_usd IS NULL;
실패한 실행이 한 건도 없는 에이전트 목록을 조회해줘
SELECT a.* FROM agents a WHERE a.agent_id NOT IN (SELECT e.agent_id FROM executions e WHERE e.status = 'failed');
특정 달(2024년 3월)에 실행된 execution의 상태별 건수를 알려줘
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM executions WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', started_at) = '2024-03' GROUP BY status;
툴 이름별 총 비용을 내림차순으로 정렬해서 보여줘
SELECT tool_name, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC;
평균 레이턴시가 가장 높은 에이전트 타입은 뭐야?
SELECT a.agent_type, AVG(e.latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY a.agent_type ORDER BY avg_latency DESC LIMIT 1;
가장 비싼 단일 툴 호출 상위 5개를 보여주세요
SELECT * FROM tool_calls ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 5;
실행 시작 후 종료까지 걸린 시간이 recorded latency_ms와 다른 실행을 찾아줘
SELECT * FROM executions WHERE ABS((strftime('%s', ended_at) - strftime('%s', started_at)) * 1000 - latency_ms) > 100;
각 에이전트별 마지막 실행 시각과 상태를 알려줘

SELECT a.agent_name, e.started_at AS last_started_at, e.status FROM executions e JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE e.started_at = (SELECT MAX(e2.started_at) FROM executions e2 WHERE e2.agent_id = e.agent_id);
총 출력 토큰이 1000 이상인 실행에 대해, 실행 ID와 연결된 에이전트 이름을 조회해줘

SELECT e.execution_id, a.agent_name, SUM(tc.output_tokens) AS total_output_tokens FROM tool_calls tc JOIN executions e ON tc.execution_id = e.execution_id JOIN agents a ON e.agent_id = a.agent_id GROUP BY e.execution_id, a.agent_name HAVING total_output_tokens >= 1000;
